claims.claim_text: At Army entry on May 9, 1941, John W. Blair's recorded civilian occupation group was farm hands on general farms.

claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier and full name link the Army record to the indexed person.
claims.temporal_assessment: The dated Army-entry record is strongly bounded pre-service evidence, but it names no farm or employer and gives no OSS start date.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Corporal Whitney Blair is confirmed against the exact-name, exact-private-identifier Army record and corroborating biographical evidence.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Born in 1924; from Wayland; served in the U.S. Army in World War II.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact Army record gives birth year 1924, Middlesex County residence, and Boston enlistment; the obituary independently describes a 1924-born Wayland resident who served in the wartime Army.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier confirms the Army match. Birth year, Wayland within Middlesex County, Boston enlistment, and wartime Army service corroborate the biographical identification beyond the distinctive full name.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record documents entry on February 10, 1943. The obituary corroborates identity but does not supply an OSS entry date.
claims.match_notes: The private identifier is withheld publicly. The obituary's later education and employment details are not converted into pre-OSS claims.

claims.claim_text: At Army entry on February 10, 1943, Whitney Blair was recorded as a student; the institution is not identified.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: NARA's fixed-width Army record carries occupation code 992, which the corrected official code list defines as students.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact private identifier and full name link the Army record to the indexed person; birth year and geographic details receive independent biographical corroboration.
claims.temporal_assessment: The dated Army-entry record establishes student status at entry but does not identify the school or the later Army-to-OSS sequence.
claims.match_notes: Student status is not employment. Although corroborating sources document Harvard affiliation, none proves that Harvard was the institution represented by the Army-entry code, so no organization is assigned.
